description: Дунаданский рейнджер из Севора. Мастер скрытности, двойного владения и лука.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.description: Become invisible for a short amount of time.  • On its own, useful for losing aggro, attack important targets such as spellcaster, reviving companions... can be further upgraded by other skills.

skills.name: Onslaught
skills.description: while evasion is active unleash a suprise heavy attack(press right mouse button) against your target for bonus damage. • does good damage, useful for assassinating spellcasters or simply to dump some damage on a target if the Evasion is close to end. Stronger if using dual wielded weapons, for some reason it does almost double the damage

skills.name: Critical Wound
skills.description: increase hero mode damage and improves the rate that your attacks build critical strikes.

skills.name: Respite
skills.description: Enables automatic health and power regeneration while evasion is active.

skills.name: Smoke and flame
skills.description: Enhance evasion by disappearing in a flash that stuns enemies.

skills.name: Stealth Mastery
skills.description: increases the duration of the evasion bonus. Evasive Foe Allows you to use normal attack(press left mouse button) without being revealed.

skills.name: Evasive Foe
skills.description: Вероятность уклонения растёт при ношении лёгкой брони.
skills.note: в вики не оформлено, из ручной сверки

skills.name: Ranger Strike
skills.description: Press RT+Y(on PlayStation 3) to perform a quick attack that strikes a single target for bonus damage. • quite a weak skill, even when upgraded

skills.name: Dual Wield
skills.description: unlocks dual wielding of 1-handed weapons and increases the damage done with them equipped.

skills.name: Combat Training
skills.description: increases the damage of your ranger strike. • since Ranger Strike is weak even with this, it's better to avoid spending points in it.

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.description: increases your damage wielding 2-handed swords.

skills.name: Dual Strike
skills.description: Press RT+X(on PlayStation 3) to attack all enemies around with both weapons - requires dual wielding. • enemies with flinch, but will not fall over. damage is quite low, but it's useful still as it's an AoE attack.

skills.name: Blood of Westernesse
skills.description: Reduces the cool-down times of active skills. • a must-have!

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: Press RT+X(on PlayStation 3) for a wide arcing attack that strikes multiple enemies. - requires a 2-handed sword. • excelent skill, does good damage, often hits the same target twice, but most importantly, if enemies are close it will knock them to the ground - best way to fight orcs when in melee, since it works on them too and the cooldown is very short.

skills.name: Might of the Dunedain
skills.description: Each killing blows grants a temporary strength bonus. • on max level, it adds +10 Strength. The way it works is, after you kill an enemy, you get +10 Strength for a short time, but you don't get any more Strength for multiple kills. 10 Strength might seem a lot at first, but it's actually just +30 melee damage

skills.name: Assail
skills.description: While blocking press RB+Y(on PlayStation 3) to rush ahead, striking targets for bonus damage. • useful for escaping tough spots, similar to Cleave, just weaker and harder to aim. It's almost the same as regular dodge roll + Cleave, just not very deadly

skills.name: Agility
skills.description: grants a bonus of armor based on your current dexterity. • very useful later in the game, when with all the gear bonuses, Eradan can have over 200 Dexterity. If you have 100 Dexterity, one point will add +100, two points +150, and three points +200 armor

skills.name: Heavy Shot
skills.description: Hold and release RT+RB(on PlayStation 3) to fire a arrow with greater power.

skills.name: Bow Mastery
skills.description: Increases the damage of your bow attacks and increases the speed you reload arrows

skills.name: Broad Quiver
skills.description: Increases the maximum number of arrows stored in your quiver.

skills.name: Stunning Shot
skills.description: Press LT+Y(on PlayStation 3) to fire an arrow that stuns your target and enables a follow-up critical attack. • very useful to have 1 point in it because the target hit will immediately be opened for a critical attack, meaning even if you're a melee fighter, you can shoot this at the first target coming at you, and you'll immediately be able to critical it and then continue to fight in hero mode. Works on ALL enemies, even trolls and bosses. Critical opening doesn't appear if the target blocks the arrow with a shield, but it will be stunned.

skills.name: Precision Aura
skills.description: A Shared bonus increases the damage each party member inflicts with headshots. • maxing this skill makes your headshots do double damage compared to normal shots.

skills.name: Volley
skills.description: Press LT+X(on PlayStation 3) to fire multiple arrows that automatically seek visible targets. • when maxed, fires 8 arrows at random 8 targets in front of you. If there are only 3 enemies, it will fire only 3 arrows. Damage per arrow is the same as a normal shot. Most useful against goblin sappers, or for killing bosses quickly if there are other enemies around - for example, if a troll is in front of you and lots of enemies are behind the troll, if you fire Volley, all 8 arrows may hit the troll, doing lots of damage quickly. • even if it fires multiple arrows, Volley depletes only 1 arrow from your quiver.

skills.name: Piercing shot
skills.description: Maximizes Heavy Shot(RT+RB) by increasing initial damage, reducing charge time and applying additional damage over time to targets. • increases the damage, but there isn't any damage over time.  ==Character builds==
